title: High On Life
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#801, 2026-10-29), the Epic copy, Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal with AVX advertised, rated 4 of 5 after 2 minutes: on the first launch the legal splash ran at about 3 fps, the second launch was fine. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on an M1 (Epic). The very first start ran its splash at a few frames per second, most likely while shaders were built, and the next start was normal.

knownIssues.symptom: The first start shows the legal splash at about 3 fps
knownIssues.cause: assumed: first-run shader compilation. Not measured
